input.brief: Roth-Feller: a private AI trading firm for everyday people; seven AI desk roles, every trade is a ticket you approve, verified track record passport

direction.name: The dark room
direction.idea: One dark field from top to bottom, and in it, lit things. Photographs and objects appear like exhibits in a dim gallery: each with space around it, each the brightest thing on its screen. Type is light, small and sparse. The darkness is not a theme switch; it is a room, and the page is a slow walk through it. It suits subjects sold on atmosphere and material: an evening restaurant, a metal card, a record, a house at dusk.
direction.composition: A single near-black or deep-toned ground runs the full page with no section bands. First screen: either the name at full width in a light weight along the bottom edge with one dim photograph above it, or one object or photograph centred at 40–50% of the viewport with a line of text beneath at 16–18px. Each later screen holds one or two lit items at a generous size (the main one 40–60% of the screen width) with its text set beside it at full reading size; the darkness frames the items, it does not replace content. Images vary in size but all share the same darkness at their edges so they sit in the ground without frames. Practical details come last in a simple two-column text block. The only solid light element on the page is the single primary action.
direction.typography: Light or regular weights; they glow on dark. Avoid heavy bold, which looks cheap on black. Headings 4–7vw at most; text 16–18px with leading 1.6 and a slightly lifted ink (not pure white).
direction.colour: A dark ground with a tint (blue-black, green-black, brown-black), a soft light ink, a dimmer ink for secondary text, and one warm or bright accent used once per screen at most.
direction.imagery: Low-key photographs: dark backgrounds, one light source, subjects emerging from shadow. Their dark edges should blend into the page ground.
direction.photoTreatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.
direction.richness: Light against dark, and the slow pacing.
direction.pitfalls: Grey text on black fails contrast quickly: check it. No glow effects, no neon accent, no coloured light blobs. A dark page with a bright busy photograph is not this direction; choose low-key images. Dark does not mean empty: every screen still carries its content at a readable size, and running text is a light ink at 7:1 or more, not a dim grey.

hero.name: Counter object, wide wordmark
hero.blueprint: Borrowed from a watch or perfume counter. One flat charcoal field. Centred slightly above the midline, a single low-key photograph of the object about 31% of the viewport wide (columns 5-8), 4:5, its own dark background matched to the field with filter: brightness(0.9) so it sits without a frame. Under it the name runs on one line as an ultra-wide wordmark spanning 72% of the width yet only about 45px tall: an extended face with letter-spacing near 0.6em, or a regular face stretched with transform: scaleX(2.4). Then one centred serif sentence at clamp(24px, 2.6vw, 38px). Then a single centred row at 15px with 48px between its three parts: one specification, the price inside the one solid light rectangle that is also the action, a second specification. The wordmark repeats small top-left and one text link sits top-right, both on 32px margins. The bottom fifth and both outer quarters of the screen stay empty and dark.
hero.mobile: The photograph grows to 70% of the width at 4:5, its top at 16% of the height. The wide wordmark spans the full width inside 20px margins at about 28px tall. The serif sentence sets at 6vw on two lines. The row stacks into three centred lines with the action in the middle at full width. The lowest sixth of the screen stays dark and empty.
hero.headline: The name as a very wide, very low wordmark on one line (up to 12 characters); the serif sentence beneath is the supporting line, up to 40 characters.

type.note: A tall, condensed high-contrast serif whose capitals read like a masthead or a shop fascia. Suits residences, hotels, restaurants and wine, where a short name can stand floor to ceiling.

palette.name: Night and cornflower
palette.note: Blue-black ground and slate panels with silver-white text fill the page; no section changes colour. Cornflower blue marks the buttons and at most one word in a heading.

photos.title: Sky and space
photos.note: skies, clouds, stars and night skies
photos.treatment: If a photograph's background is lighter than the page, darken the image slightly (`filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.05)`) rather than adding a frame.

photos.alt: Tiny silhouetted figure on a dark ridge under a blue and orange twilight sky
Clear twilight sky fading from deep blue to an orange horizon
Dark storm clouds hanging over a faint mountain ridge
White cumulus cloud rising against a dark teal sky

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Call and response column
sections.blueprint: The sequence is shown as what you give and what comes back, in one narrow column 560px wide starting at column 4, or on the page's text axis. Three exchanges, 88px apart. Each opens with a sentence at 20px medium that begins with its order word ('First, install it.' 'Then ask for a chart.'). 16px under it, the call: the literal thing the user enters, in a filled panel one tone off the ground, radius 8px, padding 20px. For a developer tool that is real code in `<pre><code>` at 14px with a working copy button; otherwise it is the product's own input holding real typed text. Under the call, indented 56px, the response: a true-size fragment marked data-ui showing what the product returns. The third response is the finished result and breaks out of the column, 760px wide, running to column 12. The heading, two to four words at 28px, sits 56px above the first sentence.
sections.mobile: The column fills the width with 20px margins. Calls and responses stack without the indent; a 24px gap and a lighter panel tone set the response apart. Code panels scroll sideways inside themselves. The final result runs edge to edge at true size, cropped on the right if wider.

sections.name: Rows as a board
sections.blueprint: The product's main list is set like a station departure board. Eight to ten real rows (transactions, issues, deploys, bookings) run the full viewport width inside 12px side margins. Each row is a filled band 72px tall, one tone off a dark ground, separated from the next by a 4px gap and never by a line; the whole board is one fragment marked data-ui. Text inside is 26–30px: the name from column 1, two or three facts at columns 6, 8 and 10, and at column 12 a status word on a solid block of its status colour; figures use tabular numerals. The section's top and bottom edges cut the first and last rows in half, so the list seems to continue. The fourth row is open: 216px tall, in the accent colour, with its detail in two lines at 17px. Clicking another row opens that one instead. No heading: the open row's name is the largest type.
sections.mobile: Rows keep the 4px gaps and are 64px tall inside 8px margins: the name at 20px on the left, the status block on the right, the other facts dropped. The open row is 200px tall and lists the dropped facts as three lines at 16px. Six rows show; the first and last are cropped.

sections.name: Giant command list
sections.blueprint: The capabilities are set as the product's own command menu, scaled up until it is the section; the root is marked data-ui. First a real search `<input>` at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px) across columns 1–10: a filled block one tone off the ground, 1.9em tall, whose placeholder of two to four words serves as the heading ('Find a command'). Beneath it six to eight capability names, one per line, at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 76px), leading 1.1, flush left, each row the full content width. At the right end of a row sits its shortcut as key caps: filled squares 1em tall, one character each, in the text face. The selected row lies on a solid block of the accent colour and shows one sentence at 17px under its name. Typing filters the rows; arrow keys and hover move the selection. Nothing else is in the section.
sections.mobile: The input is 56px tall at 20px. Capability names are set at 8.5vw, one per line; key caps are dropped, since a phone has no shortcuts. Tapping a name selects it: the accent block and the 16px sentence open beneath it and the previous one closes. Filtering still works.

sections.name: Figures inside a sentence
sections.blueprint: The numbers are written into prose and the prose is set at display size. One paragraph of two or three sentences, 22–34 words, containing three or four true figures, in the pattern 'Since 2014 we have rebuilt 340 roofs in 9 towns, and 312 of them have never leaked.' Set at clamp(32px, 4.4vw, 72px), leading 1.12, in columns 2–11, left-aligned and vertically centred in a section of 80–90svh with nothing else in it. Words are in the soft ink at regular weight; the figures alone are in full ink (or the accent) at the same size, in lining numerals, with non-breaking spaces binding each figure to its unit. No boxes, underlines or colour chips behind the figures. A visually hidden two-word heading names the section for structure; to the eye the paragraph stands alone. On a deep ground use a light weight and a soft light ink, with the figures in the brightest ink.
sections.mobile: The paragraph is 7.4vw with leading 1.2, at full width between 20px margins, vertically centred in 70svh. Keep each figure and its unit together on one line with non-breaking spaces. Nothing else appears in the section.

sections.name: Prices like a menu
sections.blueprint: Prices set the way a good menu sets them. A heading of two to three words at 32–40px sits in columns 1–3. Columns 5–12 hold the list in two text columns with a 64px gap. Items are grouped under plain group names at 24px in medium weight with 48px above each group. Each item is a row: the name at 19px on the left, the price at the same size on the right on the same baseline, with tabular figures and the currency sign shown only once per group; beneath the name, one line of description at 16px in the softer ink, no wider than 36ch. Rows are 22px apart. Name and price are joined only by empty space (flex with `justify-content: space-between`), with no dot leaders and no lines. One small photograph (4:5, three columns wide) may sit under the heading in the left zone.
sections.mobile: One column. The heading at 28px, then the photograph at 60% width if used. Each item keeps name left and price right on one line at 17px, with its description beneath in the softer ink. Group names at 20px with 40px above.

sections.name: Large questions, answers beside
sections.blueprint: Every answer is open; nothing collapses. Each question-and-answer pair is a row on the 12-column grid: the question in columns 1–6 at clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px), medium weight, leading 1.1, no more than two lines; its answer in columns 8–12 at 17–18px with leading 1.55 and a measure near 40ch, its first baseline level with the question's first baseline. Rows are separated by 72–88px of empty space and nothing else. Five to seven rows. The section heading, two or three words, is set at the same size as the questions but in the softer ink and sits as the first row's left cell with an empty right cell, so it reads as the top of the same table rather than a title above it. Because questions are large and answers small, the left column works as a scannable index.
sections.mobile: Each pair stacks: question at 24px, answer 12px beneath at 17px, then 56px of space before the next. The heading leads at the same 24px in the softer ink. Answers stay open; there is no accordion on the phone either.

sections.name: A plain sentence, one action
sections.blueprint: The page ends on an almost empty screen. On the page ground, with no band and no panel, one sentence of eight to fourteen words is set at 18–22px in the regular weight, in the full ink, no wider than 34ch, on the same left edge as the page's text column (or centred only if the whole page is centred). 24px beneath it sits one small filled button, about 40px tall with 18px side padding, and optionally one text link beside it on the same baseline. That is all. Above the sentence leave at least 30svh of empty ground and below it at least 20svh before the footer line, so the emptiness reads as decided. The sentence is written as something a person would say, and it names the action plainly. No headline-sized type appears anywhere in this section.
sections.mobile: Identical in spirit: the sentence at 18px with 20px margins, the button beneath at its natural width (not full width), 44px tall. Keep 20svh of empty ground above the sentence and 14svh below the button, before the footer line.

sections.name: A single quiet line
sections.blueprint: No footer block at all. After at least 30svh of empty page ground, one baseline 30px above the bottom edge carries three items in the page's ordinary small text size (14–16px), the same size and weight as the navigation: at the left margin, what this is in three or four words; centred, two to five links separated by 24px of space; at the right margin, the year and a privacy link. Use a three-column grid (1fr auto 1fr) so the centre group is truly centred whatever the side lengths. No logo, no background change, no line above it, no columns. Links are in the full ink; the rest in the softer ink. If the page has a narrow text column, the three items may instead sit on that column's left edge as one wrapped line. The restraint only works if the page above has already made its invitation.
sections.mobile: Three short lines at 14px on the left margin with 8px between them: the description, the links on one wrapped line, then year and privacy. Links stay in the full ink. Leave 20svh of empty ground above and 24px below.

references.name: IZANAMI
references.idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
references.hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
references.type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
references.colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
references.imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
references.layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.
references.media: A misted forest photograph covers the whole first screen under drifting cloud layers, with text on about 0.2% of the area. Then a pinned full-screen architectural scene dollies forward while overlapping collages of two or three photographs at different widths pass over it, rows pair a text column at about 28vw with a portrait flush to the right margin, and the fog band returns as a bookend; about 11 photographs, one WebGL canvas, no video.
references.motion: A warm near-black screen with the tagline already in place until about 2.5s, then a fog bank creeps in from the lower right and the chrome fades in by 4.5s; load took 7.2s. Lenis with three sticky sections scrubs the scene as the forest darkens and the camera sinks into the pavilion, photographs move at different rates, and headline lines fade in one by one; two cloud layers loop on 100s linear translates, and there is no reduced-motion rule.

references.name: Deeo Studio
references.idea: The studio's four letters as huge extruded iridescent 3D blocks tumbling across a black stage, with a quiet ultralight serif statement underneath.
references.hero: Near-black viewport. Four extruded 3D letters, each roughly 45-60% of the viewport tall, are scattered at different depths and tilts across the top 80% of the screen: one cropped by the top-left corner, one lower and left of centre, a larger one upper-right, the last cropped by the right edge. Faces are dark glass; edges catch lilac, orange and holographic rainbow light. Over them runs a slim nav: bold caps wordmark top-left at a 60px margin, three small caps links (one with a tiny yellow tag) and an outlined rounded button top-right. Bottom-left, a light serif headline at about 72px begins and is cut by the fold after two lines.
references.type: PP Editorial New Ultralight for the statement headline at about 5vw; PP Neue Montreal Book, Medium and Bold for nav, caps labels and project titles; Inter 14px body. A bold Neue Montreal line reaches 160px (11.1vw) lower on the page. Light serif against bold grotesk is the pairing.
references.colour: #0d0d0d #ffffff #b79cf0 #ff5a1f #f5f5f5 #f0e68c — Near-black page with white type; colour comes from iridescent lilac, orange and rainbow reflections on the 3D letters and from each case-study thumbnail's own palette. The digest records one light grey section.
references.imagery: Extruded glassy letterforms with holographic edge light on black; case studies as square-cornered wide video thumbnails in each client's colours on a two-column grid; one tilted old snapshot in the footer.
references.layout: Side margins of 60px. After the hero come a small left-aligned paragraph and a caps label, then a work list that opens with one full-width thumbnail and continues as two columns with staggered vertical offsets. Every item repeats the same caption row. The footer is centred.

sections.description: The serif headline finishes just below the fold at top-left. Beneath it sits a four-line 17px grotesk paragraph in a column only about 190px wide (13% of the viewport), left-aligned at the margin, followed by roughly 120px of empty black and a tiny caps section label. The right three-quarters of the screen stay completely empty.

The first project is a single thumbnail running margin to margin; the rest sit in two columns with a 14px gutter, the right column offset vertically so thumbnails never align in rows. Under each thumbnail: project name in 16px medium at left with a line of tiny grey caps disciplines beneath, and a small outlined rounded button right-aligned on the same row. Square image corners, no card containers.

A tilted, slightly warped 1990s snapshot with a year caption overlaps giant block letters of the studio name set in dark grey barely lighter than the background, each letter several hundred pixels tall. Below, a centred row of five small links and a single centred line of the light serif at about 28px with a tiny speaker icon.

steal: Render the studio name as separate 3D letters at different depths and tilts, cropped by the viewport edges, instead of a flat wordmark.
Pair the loud hero object with an ultralight serif statement at bottom-left and a deliberately tiny, narrow paragraph, leaving most of the next screen empty.
Caption every work thumbnail with the same two-ended row: name and disciplines left, small outlined button right.

references.name: Tara
references.idea: Two pastel circles, mint for saving and pink for spending, stand for the app's two accounts and recur as icon, inline dot, section colour and card gradient.
references.hero: Off-white field with no navigation, only a small bold wordmark top-left. The left column is vertically centred and starts about 8% in: a two-line headline in a wide heavy grotesk at roughly 6vw with tight leading, a grey one-line subhead beneath, then a pill-shaped email field about 400px wide with a black pill button nested inside its right end. The right half holds a 3D pair floating on the page colour: a mint-to-pink gradient bank card tilted about 30 degrees, overlapping a perspective-tilted phone showing a balance screen. Two small award badges are stacked on the right edge. Roughly half the viewport is empty.
references.type: Herokid Wide at weight 600 with -0.04em tracking for headlines, regular-width Herokid for everything else. Sentence case in the hero, all-caps for the scroll statements. Roughly 86px headline against 14px body, with a mid size of about 24px for centred explainer lines.
references.colour: #f8f8f8 #0a0a0a #c3edce #f8c7c9 #ffffff — Near-white base with black type. Mint and pink appear only as the two account colours: first as small circles, then as full-screen section fields and a soft glow behind the footer wordmark.
references.imagery: 3D bank card and tilted phone mock-ups carrying app screens, floating without a container on the page colour; later a straight-on phone on a flat mint field. Simple line icons inside solid pastel circles.
references.layout: Twenty screens of scroll but very little per screen: one centred object or statement per viewport with large empty margins. A wordmark top-left and a tiny pill button top-right persist. Full-bleed pastel fields mark the two product chapters; a row of four white cards closes.

sections.description: A pinned, nearly empty viewport where a single mint circle holding a line icon sits upper-centre with a pink circle peeking from behind it. On scroll the pink circle slides out to sit beside the mint one, overlapping slightly, each with its own icon, and three centred lines of roughly 24px text appear beneath explaining the two accounts. Nothing else is on screen.

A chapter-title screen: two words of heavy uppercase at about 5vw, centred and stacked on two lines, with a mint dot the height of the capitals sitting inline after the first word like punctuation. The dot is the same circle from the previous scene, so the colour carries its meaning straight into the full-mint section that follows.

Full-viewport mint field. A small eyebrow and a bold product name are centred near the top. Below, a straight-on phone mock-up stands just right of centre, and a short right-aligned bold claim with two lines of small text sits to its left, level with the phone's lower third. Text and phone hug the centre line, leaving both outer thirds empty.

After four white rounded cards and a repeated centred email pill, the footer is one row of small links and then the wordmark set enormous, around 45vw wide and cropped by the bottom edge. It is white on the off-white page and becomes visible only through blurred pink and mint glows placed behind the letters.

steal: Assign each product concept a colour and a shape early (two pastel circles), then reuse it as bullet, inline punctuation dot and full section background.
Nest the call-to-action button inside the email field's pill so the form reads as one object.
Set the footer wordmark in the page's own background colour and reveal it only with soft coloured glows behind the letters.
